How do you make a Formula 1 team stand out beyond the racetrack?
Victoria, Chief Marketing Operations Officer at Mercedes-AMG F1, takes us inside the team's marketing playbook. From building the Mercedes brand and creating special liveries to celebrity collaborations, the Shubman Gill and Kimi Antonelli cricket crossover, and working with drivers George Russell and Kimi, she breaks down what goes into connecting with fans around the world.
She also shares advice for anyone looking to build a career in F1 marketing.
